name: additive-contour-source-li-preservation
status: Pre-registered domain-support amendment for root math review before v2 code or scoring; first3 only if approved
amendment_reason: V1 completed first3 with all 4624 nonzero a candidates rejected because flux-level u∈[0,1] also occurred on vacuum grid-edge pixels; a=0 was the only valid map on all 578 frames. The boundary-bit invariant is physically meaningful and remains. Change only the spatial support of the SAME nine-a monotone profile family: multiply its additive flux difference by a fixed one-cell smoothstep of signed physical distance INSIDE the current additive LCFS polygon. Outside/on contour and at the grid edge the profile correction is exactly zero. No true li, parameter-grid, target or score optimization.
question: Can a deterministic interior flux-profile remap recover the ORIGINAL predicted map's own scorer-derived li after the fixed truth-assisted additive contour correction, without destroying its improved contour?
scope: Mechanism diagnostic only. The li target is computed from the original source prediction and is available without labels at inference; however the existing additive contour-corrected map still used C_true and is not deployable. No public inputs or targets and no model fit.

input.submitted_scalars: Both q95 and betaN copied bit-exact from the additive prediction (already identical to the source prediction)

family.li_target: On each frame, extract C_source from the original source psi through frozen scorer LCFS code, then li_target=derive.internal_inductance(psi_source,grid_R,grid_Z,'DIII-D',C_source). Do not read efit_li, derive_frame(psi_true), true psi, or any public label to choose a.
family.normalization: Extract C_add from the additive psi through frozen scorer code. With scorer sign s and additive map phi=s*psi_add, phi_axis at its scorer-detected integer O-point, phi_sep=median bilinear phi sampled on its 512-point C_add, span=phi_axis-phi_sep>0 and finite. Record max/p95 contour-level spread rather than rejecting on the resampling surrogate.
family.profile: Keep the SAME global nonlinear family: for 0<=u=(phi_axis-phi)/span<=1, g_a(u)=u+a*u^2*(1-u)^2; outside this u interval g_a(u)=u. Compute the global flux difference delta_a=s*(phi_axis-span*g_a(u))-psi_add in float64, then spatially restrict it by the fixed interior taper below. Endpoints and first derivatives of g match identity; g'_a(u)=1+2a*u*(1-u)*(1-2u) has minimum >0.615 on |a|<=2. Cast final psi_new=psi_add+T_inside*delta_a once to finite float32.
family.interior_support: Use the scorer's own even-odd _points_in_polygon to mark physical 65x65 grid points strictly inside the CURRENT additive C_add polygon, not C_true. For every grid point compute the exact minimum Euclidean physical distance to the 512 straight polygon segments (including the closing segment), with closest-point projection clipped to each segment. Define signed distance sdist=+d inside, -d outside, and 0 on the contour. Let width=min(diff(grid_R),diff(grid_Z)) metres, fixed at one physical grid spacing. T_inside=h(sdist/width), where h(t)=0 for t<=0, 3t^2-2t^3 for 0<t<1, 1 for t>=1. Require T_inside=0 on every grid edge and every polygon point; no clipping of psi or adaptive width. This keeps the LCFS and vacuum map unchanged in the continuous construction while allowing interior gradient changes.
family.choice: Evaluate the scorer's own internal_inductance for each VALID candidate using that candidate's own extracted contour C_a. Choose the valid a minimizing absolute li_a-li_target, ties by smallest |a| then lowest a. No truth-li target, continuous optimizer, adaptive grid, lambda change or competition-score tuning.
family.zero_control: a=0 returns the additive psi map byte for byte, never reconstructed through normalization; its source map/LCFS/li must be finite and valid, so every frame has a guaranteed candidate. If a=0 fails, abort rather than skip the frame.
family.invalid_nonzero_candidates: Keep the SAME validity gates: reject a nonzero a explicitly with per-frame reason if the candidate map is nonfinite/wrong-shape, boundary psi bits change, scorer-native LCFS is missing, magnetic axis moves by more than 0.01*min physical grid spacing, scorer-native symmetric Hausdorff(C_a,C_add) exceeds 0.1*min grid spacing, or li_a is nonfinite. Count every rejected a and reason. Do not drop a frame or silently replace a candidate; a=0 remains eligible.
family.output: Actual finite float32 compensated psi maps, original/additive q95/betaN bit-exact, selected a, source li_target, additive li at a=0, selected li, candidate validity counts and contour/axis deviations. Record inside-grid count, shell width and taper boundary max. Do not override any scorer-derived value.

smoke.purpose: Numerical correctness and source-li target matching of the fixed spatially restricted family only. The additive A baseline happens to have better true-li R2 than the original source on these three shots, so restoration toward source li may LOWER the three-shot score; do not tune the family from that outcome.
smoke.execution_gate: Code and score only after root math review of this spec. Full70 compensation requires a separate review of first3 validity, candidate rejections, li target movement and all native fields.

scoring.native_comparison: Score the additive prediction and compensated prediction on the exact same ordered filenames through unmodified frozen local_score.main. Report native S, R2psi, R2qb, D_LCFS, Consistency, all seven consistency R2, failure counts, scalar bits and stage times; no second metric implementation.

arithmetic_prospect_not_a_result.caveat: This is only score-weight arithmetic, not achievable gain or public-fold bound. Candidate remap can change psi, contour and other functionals, and the additive contour source still uses true labels.

cost_and_scope.first3_build_time_order_of_minutes: Prior nine-a B truth-li smoke took 57.3 s for 578 frames. This adds source-li extraction and candidate rejection accounting; budget roughly 1-3 minutes, then ~8 s native scorer per artifact.
cost_and_scope.full70_cost_note: About 25-40 minutes CPU by first3 scaling, no GPU fit. No full70 run in this stage.
